measurements.scope: The study identifies the Benguela Current system at 30°, 24°, and 19°S across decadal inverse solutions, with no continuity north of 19°S. The current and Benguela ecosystem have different extents. Section observations are from different cruises and do not establish a simultaneous centerline; the derived floor is unranked.
measurements.source_locator: Section 3.1.3 and Figure 5, Benguela Current system at 30°S, 24°S, and 19°S; OSW WGS84 meridional gate calculation

map_features.note: Approximate editorial locator points place a name in a recognizable region on the OSW equirectangular map. Points are neither observed cores nor endpoints or length measurements. Multi-basin family names have one point per basin and must be split into separate records before quantitative comparison.
map_features.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

map_features.note: Specified northward shelf-edge Benguela regional reference branch from an offshore Cape Agulhas regional gate to the nominal 15 degrees S Angola–Benguela front region. Excludes broad offshore Benguela extensions, Agulhas ring paths, southward undercurrent and the entire upwelling-ecosystem perimeter. Gate coordinates are OSW regional approximations; no continuous measured shelf-edge axis is inferred.
map_features.spatial_geometry_method: WGS84 geodesic legs densified at <=10 km as in the existing reference-route state join; planar relation to coarse masked OSW display polygons.

ordering_sensitivity.interpretation: Conservative positions within retained rounded route envelopes, treating choices independently; touching envelopes overlap. Not a statistical rank interval or a uniform whole-current comparison.
